entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Blood of the Beast
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have a gift for making authentic-sounding threats you never intend to follow through on.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can use the Bluff skill to demoralize opponents in combat instead of Intimidate. You can attempt a Bluff check in place of an Intimidate check when using the Dazzling Display feat and feats that list Dazzling Display as a prerequisite. If you use the Bluff skill to demoralize, you cannot use it to feint until the beginning of your next turn, and vice versa.
